changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: guidanceUrl and availability can differ between versions of the same action code, same as payment or rules, so they belong in the versioned actions_config.config JSONB rather than on the one-row-per-code actions table. Copies the current actions.guidance_url/availability values into every actions_config row for that code (not just the active one) so historical versions carry the same values forward, then drops the source columns from actions.
